purpose: Every item the operator approval of 2026-10-08 left open, in one place, so that a milestone accepting that package cannot inherit a deferral as settled. Each row names what is open, who closes it, the evidence that would close it, and whether that evidence requires the submitted original. No row closes without its evidence: harness.deferral_register.check fails the register if one does.
declared_status_note: Inferred, not Confirmed. Each row's existence is read off a committed record, which is evidence. That a row is still open is an inference from the absence of a closing decision, and an absence is not a confirmation. The operator's own review is what would move this.
supersedes: nothing. This is the first register of the deferrals of the operator approval of 2026-10-08. The records it binds are its predecessors in evidence, not in version: the approved dispositions supersede the R05 record, and this register reads the approved one. A correction to this register is a successor register, never an edit.
uncertainties: The ticket ledger is bound as a tracked input, so any edit to it - including one unrelated to the R04 criterion - makes this register stale until it is re-derived.
The R04 row closes on adoption into an active register once D13's deferral lifts, which is a decision this repository cannot make.
No row has ever been closed, so the closure path is covered by synthetic cases only.
Several rows name one observation on purpose. ESR-E-04 carries three and ESR-Q-01 three. The cross-reference is what keeps them from being counted as separate items.
DQ-08's subject, the M7.3 milestone and the appointment windows, is not an evaluation summary observation, so it joins the ticket criterion as a row naming none.
authority_note: This register is a successor artifact. It confers no authority, closes no row and edits none of the records it binds. An operator approval is an authority fact; Confirmed, Inferred, Assumed and Unresolved describe evidence, and approving the package that contains a deferral does not resolve the deferral.

statements.claim: The integrity audit's recorded 40 to 29 to 13 finding sequence is three readings of one unchanged candidate. All three carry the same candidate hash and the same document id, so the fall reflects changed interpretation and changed audit rules — operator decision D11 and ticket R03 retired 27 findings as rules, not as repairs. It is not 27 repaired proposal defects, and no proposal text changed between the three readings.
